operator/anna_background: Anna Drake was born in Vienna, where she enjoyed hiking and skiing in the nearby wilderness. Her pleasant life was destroyed during the Nazi invasion. Kristallnacht demolished her home and heritage, and her family and friends were executed one by one. When the Nazis took Anna prisoner, she was the last surviving member of her family. She bravely escaped and joined the Ö5 resistance group.
operator/arthur_background: Arthur was born in Cameroon to a wealthy noble family. He was educated in England at Cambridge, where he studied international affairs. Detesting fascism, he joined the British military to fight the Nazis and liberate Europe. After proving his leadership in Operation Tonga, Arthur was chosen to lead a new team of international soldiers. He was the first recruit of the SOTF.
operator/beatrice_background: As a child, Béatrice went to bed each night listening to her mother read stories, sparking a passion for learning that fueled her career as a teacher. Béatrice saw her fiance and her students jailed during a mass arrest of Jewish families. Horrified by the atrocities of fascism, she took up arms and joined the French resistance. She fought in the liberation of Paris and was eventually reunited with her love.
operator/constanze_background: Constanze was born in Dusseldorf to two loving parents. When she was ten, the Nazis rose to power and she was forced to don the BDM uniform, but defied her superiors at every turn. In Poland, she met a girl — a Polish resistance fighter — and they fell in love. Years later, she joined the SOE alongside her Polish lover and helped punch a hole through the German defensive line in support of the Allied invasion.
operator/daniel_background: Daniel was born to two Japanese immigrants who ran an auto shop in Los Angeles. After the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, the US government took away his family’s home and business, then incarcerated them in a concentration camp. Despite the mistrust of his own nation, Daniel was drafted into service to protect it. He was deployed as a sniper in Italy as part of a segregated unit of Japanese-Americans.
operator/florence_background: Born and raised in Alabama, Florence dreamed of representing her country as a fighter pilot since she was a little girl. During WWII, she was determined to make those dreams come true, but was turned away from those opportunities due to both her gender and her race. After the war, the SOTF recognized her talent and passion for being in the sky and Florence has flown as a rescue helicopter pilot for them ever since.
operator/francis_background: Born in the territory of Hawaii, Francis grew up surrounded by an array of new food brought by immigrants from all over the world. He wants to do right by his Japanese-American friends, who suffered inhumane experiences in internment camps like the one he ignorantly guarded during his time in Honolulu. Francis is passionate and light-hearted and lives everyday like it’s his last.
operator/francis_hobbies: Cooking for himself and fellow soldiers
operator/gustavo_background: A wealthy playboy, Gustavo dos Santos fled Brazil to be a frivolous socialite in Paris. After a chance encounter with a French resistance agent revealed Germany's secret plans for Brazil, Gustavo risked his life to deliver the intelligence to his homeland. He joined the "Smoking Cobras," (also known as the Brazilian Expeditionary Force) and took Monte Castello, the last line of Nazi defenses in Northern Italy.
operator/halima_background: Halima was born in Mogadishu to a Somali mother and an influential Italian fascist. Her family moved to Italy where they lived in luxury. After her family returned to Somalia, Halima witnessed the harsh reality of authoritarian rule and the cruelty of colonialism. Instead of fleeing with her family, Halima joined the Somali resistance to fight the Italian occupation.
operator/isabella_background: Born in the territory of the Philippine Islands, Isabella was trained in Arnis and hand-to-hand combat by her father, an officer in the 57th Infantry Regiment. After the Japanese invasion of 1942, Isabella’s father was captured and killed during the Bataan Death March. Wracked with grief, Isabella fled to the Caraballo Mountains and joined the Hukbalahap Resistance to seek justice for her father.
operator/lewis_background: Lewis was born in Mobile County, Alabama. As a child he’d go fishing with his grandfather and brother Marcus and learned to be patient while watching his line. He began working as a shrimp fisherman, and later joined the Civilian Conservation Corp. Lewis is a calm and quiet man who survives against all odds because of his resourcefulness and careful consideration learned from his fishing days.
operator/lucas_background: Lucas is a sweetheart with a sweet tooth. He was born on a sheep farm just outside of Melbourne, Australia, and while he loved his home, he always dreamed of seeing the world. When the Second World War began, he didn’t hesitate to sign up and join the fight. Lucas is a gentle giant who prefers explosive methods of problem solving.
operator/lucas_hobbies: Competitive sheep shearing, eating lamingtons, playing cards
operator/mateo_background: Mateo was born into a large immigrant family in Texas, dreaming of becoming a civil engineer. He joined the Navy during World War II, fighting as a tail gunner in the Pacific. After witnessing growing prejudice and racism against his people following the war, Mateo threw himself into campaigning for his people, speaking out against these injustices as well as helping reunite families across the Mexican border.
operator/padma_background: Padmavati was born in India during the British Raj. Her family labored for wealthy foreigners who dictated their lives. She found joy in music and poetry, which fostered her idealism and strengthened her disgust with colonial rule. By joining the Indian National Army to fight the British occupation, Padmavati found her true calling. She became a warrior poet on the battlefield, inspiring others with her courage.
operator/padma_hobbies: Writing poetry, singing folk songs, playing the Swarmandal
operator/polina_background: Polina was a quiet girl, born and raised in Stalingrad. In 1942, she assisted the war effort as a nurse for the Medical Support Battalion, but during the Nazi invasion of Stalingrad, she joined the fight as a deadly sniper. Her rage is fueled by her grief, loneliness, and need for vengeance. She will stop at nothing to make sure evil men know true suffering.
operator/roland_background: Roland was forcibly conscripted by the German Army after the invasion of Luxembourg. He reluctantly served in order to keep his family safe. When the Nazis betrayed him and sent his family to a concentration camp, Roland deserted his post and rampaged through Europe to save his loved ones. Sadly, he failed to rescue them. Roland’s vengeful path earned him the attention of Butcher, who recruited him to a new cause .
operator/roland_hobbies: Playing cards, reading books on history and military campaigns
operator/shigenori_background: Shigenori was born a descendant of samurai. He was conscripted into the Japanese navy and took part in the invasion of New Guinea. After enduring abuse under his commanding officer and witnessing atrocities inflicted by his peers, he was falsely charged for desertion and sentenced to execution. Knowing that he would become a pariah to his people, Shigenori turned himself in to Allied troops and joined their fight.
operator/solange_background: An exceptional track runner and physics student, Solange excelled at university life. Once the war began, she fled Amsterdam with her fellow Jewish students and settled in London, where she caught the eye of the SOE. Her strategic mind and bold fearlessness both proved crucial to the war effort. Her goal is to bring an end to the conflict and return to the academic life she dearly loves.
operator/solange_hobbies: Track and field, listening to classical music, mathematics
operator/thomas_background: Thomas was born in New Carlisle Quebec to a French father and a Spanish mother, and grew up in Spain. He fought in World War 1, served as a volunteer for the Mackenzie-Papineau Battalion, and drove tanks in World War 2. His battle experience hardened him, but only out of care for his soldiers in an attempt to send everyone back home. He loves his partner and is optimistic about returning to him after the war.
operator/wade_background: Raised in Brooklyn, Wade was a bright kid but bored by schoolwork. As a teen, he grew interested in machines and eventually drag racing, which satisfied his ever-growing need for speed. His time spent behind the wheel paid off when he was accepted to the Navy’s aviation cadet program. He eventually earned his wings and found his purpose in a dive bomber cockpit.
operator_tudenver/lion_background: Growing up in Long Beach, California, Snoop Dogg realized he had a talent for rapping at a young age and began to pursue it as a career. Now, he is still releasing music and appearing as a media personality on multiple shows, but in his free time, he chooses to fight as an operator in Call of Duty.
operator_tufoxtrot/kim_background: Trained by her mother as a fighter, Tae Young donned a mask to conceal her identity while helping families cross the North Korean border to safety. She soon earned a reputation amongst the Korean people as a local folk hero and keeper of justice. Even the briefest glimpse of her Dokkaebi mask instills hope in her people and fear in her enemies.
operator_tugolf/callum_background: All his life, Callum was a showoff, constantly adventuring and getting into trouble with neighbors, woodland creatures, the law – everyone. His unwavering spirit helped him quickly ascend the ranks of the British Army to eventually become a recruit trainer. In World War II, Callum, harboring deep hatred for Nazis and their ideals, fought hard for a future without them. Currently he is the trainer for all SOTF agents.
operator_tugolf/carver_background: Butcher served in the British Army during Operation Devon, battling against the 16th Panzer Division. He was dismissed after sustaining injuries to his face from exploding shrapnel but returned to the front lines soon after as duty called. There he witnessed resistance fighters in action. Inspired, went on to become the founder and recruiter for the Special Operations Task Force. The rest, as they say, is history.
operator_tugolf/carver_hobbies: Leading the SOE, who has time to faff about?
operator_tuhotel/doggett_background:
The Model T-1000 is an advanced AI model made from liquid metal.  Its passion is infiltrating the human resistance, its focus is terminating their members, and it is relentless in both of these pursuits.
It likes shapeshifting, hunting, time travel, and any means of destruction and demolition.
It dislikes sleep, food, welding machines and all water sports.
operator_tuhotel/doggett_hobbies: Shapeshifting, Hunting, Time Travel, any means of destruction
operator_tuhotel/ikenna_background: Ikenna Olowe understood strategy from a young age. As a child in Nigeria, he excelled at chess, quickly surpassing his teachers. He grew strong studying Gidigbo, a martial battle of wits. Balanced in body and mind, Ikenna joined the war effort as a battlefield engineer. His work established critical supplies lines across the globe. Ikenna became a grand planner, knowing when to build and when to demolish.
operator_tuhotel/palmer_background:
The Model T-800 is described by Skynet as the first cybernetic organism, perfectly able to blend in with humans as it has living tissue over a hyper alloy skeleton.  After a mid-life crisis, its passion becomes protecting John Connor, acting like a stepfather to him.  Its focus is terminating threats, and yet it has no preferred fighting style: it is comfortable with weapons, vehicles and even hand to hand combat.
It likes leather jackets, motorcycles, using slang expressions, and the occasional bar fight.
It dislikes weaknesses, boxes of long-stemmed roses, and broken sunglasses.
operator_tuhotel/palmer_hobbies: Leather Jackets, Motorcycles, Slang Expressions, the occasional bar fight.
operator_tuindia/khalid_background: Khaled Al-Asad grew up in Urzikstan amid political strife. He was drawn to the words of Omar Sulaman, and joined the Al-Qatala terrorist group. He was imprisoned, but escaped after Sulaman’s death to take control of Al-Qatala. His leadership transformed the militants into an army, as he acquired an arsenal for the invasion of Verdansk. Committed to the demise of Western power, Al-Asad launched gas attacks in Verdansk, breaking a fragile armistice between nations.
operator_tuindia/raul_background: Raul Menendez was born in Nicaragua, where his childhood was clouded by the brutal revolution of US-backed Contras. His father founded the Menendez Cartel and was assassinated by the CIA at the height of his power, leaving Raul in charge. But it was the death of his sister Josephina that focused his rage, driving him to become a hostile political activist. His charisma and ruthlessness propelled him to leadership of the social movement turned terrorist organization Cordis Die.
operator_tujuliet/gabriel_background: Gabriel Rorke graduated from the US Naval Academy and became a Captain in the Marines. During an assassination mission in Caracas, Venezuela, Rorke braved the flooding city to locate and kill General Diego Almagro, leader of the Federation. During the chaos of his squad’s extraction, Rorke was left behind. He was found by The Federation, who brainwashed away his loyalties, turning him into a man with an undying vendetta against his own.
operator_tujuliet/seraph_background: Seraph grew up in the Singapore Quarantine Zone, daughter of a high ranking officer of the 54 Immortals. She honored her lineage and excelled within the syndicate becoming its youngest ever Enforcer. She is a living embodiment of the 54I's will, strictly quelling dissent within its ranks, while projecting the syndicate’s force and ambition wherever it's needed. Her dedication and skills are unmatched, as she proved when she willingly offered her own arm in return for the honor of receiving a cybernetic limb from the 54I.

^$^BIndependent:^R^7 Aiming Down Sights zooms the field of view to its usual value.

vidsubtitles/mp_chl_vo_001_butcher_somet: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Sometimes you need a job done.
vidsubtitles/mp_chl_vo_002_butcher_mad_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Maybe you've got to stop a mad man.
vidsubtitles/mp_chl_vo_005_butcher_when_: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7That's when you call the professionals.
vidsubtitles/mp_chl_vo_009_butcher_get_i: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Because if there's a job to do, professionals are the ones who get it done.
vidsubtitles/mp_lau_vo_004_butcher_upsid: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Their lives turned upside down by the Reich.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ana_vo_001_butcher_g: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7The German occupation of Austria shattered families.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ana_vo_002_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Those who fought back forged a new family.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ana_vo_003_butcher_a: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Anna Drake lost all she loved to the Nazis.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ana_vo_005_butcher_r: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Rage this fierce can't be caged.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ana_vo_006_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Some fires are too hot to snuff.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ana_vo_008_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7As long as the world needs vengeance, survivors will find a way.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_art_vo_001_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7A true king fights side by side with his soldiers.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_art_vo_003_butcher_l: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Leadership and loyalty sustain each other...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_art_vo_004_butcher_r: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Each relying on the other's sacrifice.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_art_vo_005_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7A covenant forged in trust and strengthened by empathy.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_art_vo_006_butcher_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Like a true monarch, Arthur Kingsley doesn't rule. He leads.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_bea_vo_001_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7When someone threatens everything you love, you have a choice.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_bea_vo_002_butcher_b: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Will you bend and yield? Or will you rise and stand?
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_bea_vo_003_butcher_b: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Beatrice Mercier made her choice the day she saw her people suffer.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_bea_vo_004_butcher_l: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Because to live a life of fear is no life at all.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_002_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Tough to be in work like this.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_003_butcher_i: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But if I was sentimental, it'd be for a gun.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_004_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Maybe it'd be old, passed down over generations.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_005_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Maybe my father would've taught me how to hold it.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_006_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7And he'd remind me it wasn't about when I chose to shoot it...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_007_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But how often I chose not to.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_008_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7He'd make it so when I did use that old, rusty pistol...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_009_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7When I made me own choice...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_014_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7So it's just a fuckin' gun.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_but_vo_016_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Every gun has its purpose... The right tool for the job.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_cal_vo_002_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Callum Hendry was made for war.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_cal_vo_003_butcher_h: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7His highland blood calls him to action.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_cal_vo_005_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7No limits to what he'll do to win.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_cal_vo_007_butcher_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7He'll make a mess of you.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_con_vo_001_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Constanze Muller lived a life fashioned by the Reich.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_con_vo_002_butcher_a: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Until she decided on some alterations.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_con_vo_003_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7You can't change your past, but you can choose how it molds you.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_con_vo_004_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7With the right chisel, an artist can shape the future.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_dan_vo_001_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Soldiers of honor have a rule...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_dan_vo_003_butcher_d: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But for Daniel Take Yatsu, it's not just a rule...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_dan_vo_005_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7No matter how fierce the enemy...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_dan_vo_008_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7He's there to make good on a promise.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_flo_vo_001_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Florence Carter wasn't allowed to be a combat pilot in the war.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_flo_vo_002_butcher_r: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7So now, she rescues people instead.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_flo_vo_003_butcher_h: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7As long as she has her chopper, she'll never leave anyone behind.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_flo_vo_004_butcher_a: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7She'll always find her way back into the sky.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_fra_vo_001_butcher_h: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Sometimes a helping hand is all you need.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_fra_vo_002_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Francis Lanakila is that hand for everyone.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_fra_vo_004_butcher_b: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Barging headfirst into danger is easy when you have the strength of a bull.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_fra_vo_005_butcher_g: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7He's just here for a good time.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_gus_vo_001_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Some soldiers weren't so lucky when they were forced to fight in a war for which they weren't prepared.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_gus_vo_004_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But if there's one thing about Gustavo dos Santos...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_gus_vo_005_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7He's always gonna try his luck.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_gus_vo_007_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Whether it's a night at the casino...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_gus_vo_008_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Or a night raiding Nazi intel...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_gus_vo_009_butcher_h: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7You can bet Gustavo's gonna hit the jackpot.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_hal_vo_001_butcher_h: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Halima Zambardi grew up with the finest things in life.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_hal_vo_002_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But when that life was taken away...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_hal_vo_003_butcher_d: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7She discovered something richer than wine and gold.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_hal_vo_004_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7To Halima, freedom used to mean doing as she pleased.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_hal_vo_006_butcher_w: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Freedom means doing what is right.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ike_vo_002_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7No sense in fighting fair when a single trap will do the job.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ike_vo_003_butcher_b: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7For Ikenna Olowe, the best strategy is to always have a backup plan.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ike_vo_004_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7The battlefield is a chessboard full of gambits, baits, and snares.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ike_vo_005_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Think you're winning one second, when defeat is just turns away.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ike_vo_006_butcher_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7When you play against a master of the game, they can seal victory in just a few moves.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_ike_vo_007_butcher_i: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7The rest is just playin' out the inevitable.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_isa_vo_001_butcher_i: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Isabella Reyes lost everything she loved to the war.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_isa_vo_002_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7What she kept was her father's discipline to fight against oppressors.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_isa_vo_003_butcher_o: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7As long as she's victorious, she keeps the memory of her family alive.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_lew_vo_001_butcher_l: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7It takes a lot of patience to do what Lewis Howard does.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_lew_vo_002_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Patience, and a calm, steady hand.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_lew_vo_004_butcher_i: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Means it's important to remember what "calm" feels like.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_lew_vo_005_butcher_h: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7A feeling where your hands don't shake and your ears don't ring.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_lew_vo_007_butcher_w: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7And that you will live to see it again.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_luc_vo_001_butcher_l: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Lucas Riggs is always up for a challenge.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_luc_vo_002_butcher_i: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7If you tell him something's impossible...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_mat_vo_001_butcher_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Mateo Hernandez doesn't go looking for danger...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_mat_vo_002_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But when it finds him, he's ready.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_mat_vo_003_butcher_d: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Pressure is what brings out that diamond underneath.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_mat_vo_004_butcher_d: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7So even in those darkest moments, you can count on Mateo to shine.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_pad_vo_001_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Colonizers spill enough blood to plant their flag, then wonder why the tree of liberty gets a thirst for the stuff.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_pad_vo_003_butcher_y: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7And their yoke on her people.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_pad_vo_004_butcher_c: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7For her, casting off the bonds of imperialism was a brutal poetry.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_pad_vo_005_butcher_k: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7She always had a knack for irony.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_pol_vo_004_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Polina Petrova is always the hunter.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_rol_vo_001_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7You steal a man from his family...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_rol_vo_002_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7And force a gun in his hand...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_rol_vo_003_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Who you think he's gonna point it at first?
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_rol_vo_004_butcher_r: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Roland Zeimet was just conscripted meat for the grinder.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_rol_vo_006_butcher_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Threaten a man's family, you bind him with fear.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_rol_vo_007_butcher_r: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But kill all he loves, that fear becomes rage.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_shi_vo_001_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Shigenori Ota was once a servant to the shackles of tyranny.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_shi_vo_002_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7One night, he chose to fight back.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_shi_vo_003_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Since then, his struggle has never stopped.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_sol_vo_001_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Solange Harderwijk was an excellent sprinter.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_sol_vo_002_butcher_e: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7She was also excellent at physics.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_sol_vo_004_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7She had the perfect life as a student...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_sol_vo_005_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7So perfect that she caught the attention of people that could use her talents.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_sol_vo_006_butcher_b: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7As soon as the war's over, she'll be back.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tae_vo_002_butcher_l: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7There's a legend of a demon who lies in wait at night.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tae_vo_003_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Teeth sharp... Claws long... A smile wide and bright.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tae_vo_004_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7It's strong, and fast, and silent. It's terror on display.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tae_vo_005_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Fear not if you are human. Monsters are its prey.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tae_vo_006_butcher_f: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But its fearsome reputation is a performance for the world.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tae_vo_007_butcher_d: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7And the demon laughs behind the mask. For she knows...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_001_butcher_t: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Thomas Bolt always began his letters the same way...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_003_thomas_i_: ^8Thomas Bolt (voice): ^7"I imagine you are sitting with a cup of coffee, listening to the neighborhood kids play baseball."
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_004_thomas_ha: ^8Thomas Bolt: ^7"I know I haven't written for a while. I'm sorry about that."
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_005_thomas_th: ^8Thomas Bolt: ^7"I thought I was protecting you from all this..."
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_009_thomas_on: ^8Thomas Bolt: ^7"Scared that one day, these letters may stop returning."
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_011_thomas_wo: ^8Thomas Bolt: ^7"I would die for you, Bradley."
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_tms_vo_012_thomas_dy: ^8Thomas Bolt: ^7"And dying for the people you love?"
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_wad_vo_001_butcher_m: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7A man's whole life is nothing but one moment after another.
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_wad_vo_002_butcher_w: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7For Wade Jackson, each moment is a chance to win the fight...
vidsubtitles/mp_opv_wad_vo_005_butcher_n: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Never ask Wade what he's gonna do next.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_001_log_missio: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7Mission Log #113: Operation Vulcan. Pacific, 1944.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_002_log_cruisi: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7I was cruising above the Pacific Ocean with Trident.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_003_log_rumors: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7Seeing if those secret Nazi rumors were true.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_006_log_knew_c: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7Those fuckers knew we were coming, and didn't waste any time trying to take us out.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_007_log_sent_t: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7I sent Trident down on their own while I got the plane the fuck out of there. They knew what to do.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_009_log_triden: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7Trident kicked ass and completed the mission.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_010_log_rescue: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7They'd come rescue me soon after.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_012_log_secret: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7The Nazis thought they could keep all their secrets buried, but I was rarely far behind.
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_015_log_knew_o: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7I knew one thing for certain...
vidsubtitles/mp_s1_cin_vo_016_log_never_: ^8Butcher Mission Log (voice): ^7The world would never be ready for what I found.
vidsubtitles/mp_s2_cin_vo_001_butcher_in: ^8Captain Butcher (voice): ^7Intel from the island disclosed Nazis holed up in the Alps...
vidsubtitles/mp_s2_cin_vo_002_butcher_wa: ^8Captain Butcher (voice): ^7Waiting out the storm with some weapon called 'Nebula.'
vidsubtitles/mp_s2_cin_vo_003_butcher_co: ^8Captain Butcher (voice): ^7I couldn't let 'em use it, whatever it was.
vidsubtitles/mp_s2_cin_vo_004_butcher_ca: ^8Captain Butcher (voice): ^7So I called in the cavalry and put together a team.
vidsubtitles/mp_s2_cin_vo_005_butcher_sc: ^8Captain Butcher (voice): ^7When it came to scaling mountains and hard, cold Nazi killing, Task Force Yeti had mastered both.
vidsubtitles/mp_s2_cin_vo_007_anna_not_a: ^8Anna Drake: ^7-or not at all. We'll see you soon.
vidsubtitles/mp_s35_cin_vo_001_butcher_s: ^8Captain Butcher (voice): ^7It wasn't until some time later that we realized a storm was coming.
vidsubtitles/mp_s35_cin_vo_002_butcher_p: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Something far more powerful and fearsome than anything we could ever hope to comprehend.
vidsubtitles/mp_s3_cin_vo_002_butcher_ne: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7The Nazis set off Nebula bombs across the world.
vidsubtitles/mp_s3_cin_vo_003_butcher_pa: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Paris, London, Moscow... and now, Caldera Island.
vidsubtitles/mp_s3_cin_vo_004_butcher_te: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7I ordered Team Harpy to intercept the package and make the Nazi bastards miserable along the way.
vidsubtitles/mp_s3_cin_vo_006_butcher_st: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7But what none of us knew was that a storm was on the horizon.
vidsubtitles/mp_s3_cin_vo_007_butcher_so: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7With Nebula, the Nazis had unwittingly shaken something awake.
vidsubtitles/mp_s3_cin_vo_008_butcher_po: ^8Captain Butcher: ^7Something far more powerful and fearsome than anything we could ever hope to comprehend.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv2_mwo_vo_001_arthur_wa: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Wade would rather have been called a hotshot than a hero.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv2_mwo_vo_003_arthur_gr: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7He is one of the war's greatest pilots, but he needed a team.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv2_mwo_vo_004_arthur_pr: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The problem was getting him to admit it.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_003_wade_dont: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7Don't everybody rush over at once.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_005_richter_n: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Isn't this a nice, little reunion?
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_007_arthur_wa: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7For all we knew, he was dead.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_012_richter_d: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Do not lie to me again.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_014_officer_w: ^9Nazi Officer: ^7What are you doing? Get away from me! Take- take your hands off me!
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_016_officer_h: ^9Nazi Officer: ^7It's treachery of the highest order!
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_018_officer_h: ^9Nazi Officer (struggling): ^7You haven't heard the last of this!
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_026_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7Reports indicate he took his own life.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_031_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7I trust you have new information.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_036_richter_a: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7The American was the sixth man.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_037_richter_b: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7But I believe I have finally broken them.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_041_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7There is nothing left for us here.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_042_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7If the Reich is to live on...
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_043_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7I must know there is safe passage to Tempelhof.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_044_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7I was counting on you, Richter.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_047_richter_g: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I will get you what you require! I swear to you.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_052_polina_ou: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7Richter is onto us. We're out of time.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_054_wade_geta: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7I tried to nab us a getaway plane, but that didn't work.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_055_wade_time: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7By the time I got here, you-
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_056_wade_lock: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7You guys were already locked up.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_058_wade_borr: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7I borrowed a bomb from the Ruskies and turned myself in. We got about, uh-
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_059_wade_abou: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7Well, about an hour before that wall blows wide open and we waltz right outta here.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_063_wade_ace_: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7A fucking 'Ace' pilot is what you mean.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_064_lucas_wit: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7I'm with the Lady, what the hell do you know about explosives?
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_065_wade_fuck: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7Yeah? Well, fuck you too then.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_066_arthur_il: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7I'll tell you why we can trust him.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv3_p04_di_068_arthur_wa: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Wade's more than capable of getting us out, files in hand.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv4_bvi_di_004_mateo_you: ^8Mateo Hernandez: ^7No, no, no! Wade, you're crazy! Let 'em go!
vidsubtitles/sp_bv5_bvi_vo_001_arthur_da: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7When Wade was airborne, he was the most dangerous thing in the skies.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv5_bvi_vo_002_arthur_fl: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But if you fly too close to the sun...
vidsubtitles/sp_bv5_bvi_vo_003_arthur_wi: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Eventually, your wings will get burned.
vidsubtitles/sp_bv6_bvb_di_001_mateo_don: ^8Mateo Hernandez: ^7Dammit, Wade! I said don't move!
vidsubtitles/sp_el1_tko_vo_001_arthur_it: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7On the coast of Italian Libya, an Australian private and a group of Rats had given Rommel a huge black eye.
vidsubtitles/sp_el1_tko_vo_002_arthur_th: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Their actions should have earned them medals, and maybe even a shred of respect.
vidsubtitles/sp_el1_tko_vo_003_arthur_ha: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Hamms didn't see it that way.
vidsubtitles/sp_el1_tko_vo_004_arthur_ti: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Their reward was some time in the brig.
vidsubtitles/sp_el1_tko_vo_005_arthur_ro: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7However, all Richter seemed to care about was Rommel and his connection to Freisinger.
vidsubtitles/sp_el1_tko_vo_006_arthur_fo: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7That fool would listen to Lucas as long as we needed him to.
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_002_loudspeak: ^9Nazi Loudspeaker (German): ^7City defenses breached. All personnel evacuate via the tunnels.
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_003_lucas_cau: ^8Lucas Riggs (laughing): ^7I caught "tunnels" - what was the rest?
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_004_richter_l: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7We have very little time. Tell me, what did Freisinger want with Rommel?
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_005_lucas_tho: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7I thought you wanted to know about our team.
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_006_richter_a: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Answer me now or our deal is off!
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_007_lucas_und: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7Okay, okay. Don't get your undies in a twist.
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_008_arthur_pa: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Lucas piled it on like a champ.
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_009_arthur_te: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7He didn't have to tell Richter anything more than the lies that Nazi already told himself.
vidsubtitles/sp_el2_p07_di_010_arthur_th: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7That was the Third Reich for you.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_000_alamein_c:
^7El Alamein, 1942
^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The thing is, he was like a magnet for that kind of luck.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_001_arthur_mi: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7You'd think we'd need a miracle for Lucas to pull this off.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_002_arthur_ma: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The thing is, he was like a magnet for that kind of luck.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_003_arthur_li: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7There's that saying about lightning striking twice...
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_004_arthur_to: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Yet, Lucas had managed to find himself first at Tobruk, and then at El Alamein.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_005_arthur_al: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The world knew of an Allied victory in North Africa.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_006_arthur_br: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But it wasn't because of British Commanders or mighty tanks.
vidsubtitles/sp_el3_eli_vo_008_arthur_ea: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And Richter was eating it up.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_001_arthur_su: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Surviving Stalingrad was no small feat.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_003_arthur_no: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But no one really escapes something like that.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_004_arthur_na: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The Nazi war machine had touched all our lives. Burned away something important.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_005_arthur_at: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7I think that's what made us attractive to the S.O.E. in the first place.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_006_arthur_po: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But for Polina... The wound was marrow-deep.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_007_arthur_de: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7She was destined to return the favor.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw1_sso_vo_008_arthur_de: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And that had made her the deadliest member of my team.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_002_richter_c: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7You couldn't even save the life of your own father.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_003_richter_i: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7So tell me, why's an Ivan with an old rifle part of a top-secret Allied operation?
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_004_polina_li: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7You do not scare me, little mouse.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_007_richter_f: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I do not need you to fear me.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_009_richter_c: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7That will convince your friends to talk.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_010_polina_wo: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7Why? Because I am a woman?
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_012_polina_no: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7You're not very good at this, are you?
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_014_richter_o: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7What other missions the Allies have in Germany.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_017_richter_w: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7What is worth talking about, Fräulein?
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_022_richter_s: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Send me all the records on a Commander Steiner.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_023_richter_p: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7And any photographs of the Russian sniper.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_024_richter_l: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7'Lady Nightingale,' yes. That one. And-
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_025_richter_f: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Herr Freisinger. I was just coming to see you.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_026_richter_c: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7We have confirmation from the woman: the sixth Ally is dead.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_032_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7The prisoners made a fool of you, Richter.
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_033_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7And now you have made a fool of ME!
vidsubtitles/sp_mw2_p03_di_034_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7The American is being brought here now.

vidsubtitles/sp_ou1_tho_di_031_arthur_mi: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Our mission was complete, but there'd be more.
vidsubtitles/sp_ou1_tho_di_032_arthur_fo: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Forged in the fires, we were the tip of the spear.
vidsubtitles/sp_pi1_pri_di_002_arthur_fi: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The final push into the heart of darkness.
vidsubtitles/sp_pi1_pri_di_003_arthur_si: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The S.O.E. had recruited the six of us, under my command, for one reason.
vidsubtitles/sp_pi1_pri_di_004_arthur_pr: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7To retrieve files on the top secret Project Phoenix, the last gasp of the Third Reich.
vidsubtitles/sp_pi1_pri_di_005_arthur_al: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7A coalition of Allied commandos thrown together and aimed at where our enemy was most vulnerable.
vidsubtitles/sp_pi1_pri_di_006_arthur_fi: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7This was meant to be our first and only mission...
vidsubtitles/sp_rs15_p02_vo_001_arthur_f: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7From all the flags waving on the streets, we'd never have known the Nazis were about to lose the war.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs15_p02_vo_002_arthur_b: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But bullies are always loudest when they're scared.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs15_p02_vo_003_arthur_d: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And when they're desperate, they get stupid.

vidsubtitles/sp_rs15_p02_vo_005_arthur_f: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And he'd given us a free ride right into the lion's den.

vidsubtitles/sp_rs1_tno_vo_002_arthur_ho: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And we'd honored the memory of all those we'd lost the only way we could.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs1_tno_vo_004_arthur_so: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7You look at the soldiers under your command...
vidsubtitles/sp_rs1_tno_vo_005_arthur_di: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And hope that they can do the difficult thing. The impossible thing.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs1_tno_vo_006_arthur_fl: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7That flare told me I'd been right.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs1_tno_vo_007_arthur_be: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7This is what it means to be a leader.

vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_030_arthur_ea: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Even then, Richter was easy to read.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_031_arthur_hi: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Uniform said high rank. No combat medals. Office rat. The perfect mark.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_032_arthur_su: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Surrounded by three guards, all armed. And all wankers.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_033_richter_m: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7In all my years studying the Allies, I have never come across such an unusual unit.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_036_richter_f: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I have spoken with the Führer on exactly one occasion.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_037_richter_b: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7He recommended a book to me.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_038_richter_p: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7'The Passing of the Great Race.' By an American. A man named Madison Grant.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_039_richter_p: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7The Führer had nothing but praise for him.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_042_richter_b: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7The book reveals that under extreme duress, or unfavorable conditions, your people...

vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_045_arthur_su: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Right of the suprasternal notch, below the clavicle.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_046_arthur_ra: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Once we had what we needed from this racist bastard...
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_047_arthur_my: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7That's where I would put my knife.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_048_arthur_pl: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7My plan began to take shape.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_049_arthur_ge: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7We were being held in the basement of Gestapo Headquarters.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_050_arthur_tr: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Around and above us was a treasure trove of classified Nazi Intelligence.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_051_arthur_pr: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Project Phoenix had to be there somewhere.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_053_arthur_in: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7He thought he was the interrogator.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_054_arthur_an: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7If he was to be any of use to us...
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_055_arthur_th: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7He'd have to keep thinking that.

vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_057_arthur_fo: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7The hard part wouldn't be fooling Richter into spilling what he knew of Project Phoenix.
vidsubtitles/sp_rs2_p02_di_058_arthur_no: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7The hard part would be convincing the others not to kill him first.

vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_001_arthur_st: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Stalingrad. The city that arrested the Nazi's eastern expansion.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_002_arthur_ru: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Had the city fallen, Russia would have crumbled.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_003_arthur_ge: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The Germans underestimated Russia's will to survive.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_004_arthur_un: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7They underestimated the city, and her defenders.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_005_arthur_pe: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The people looked to Polina as a symbol of hope.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_006_arthur_he: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But she didn't want to be a hero.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_008_arthur_ar: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The arrogance of the Third Reich was to think they could achieve what the great Napoleon could not.
vidsubtitles/sp_rw4_swi_vo_011_arthur_ni: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Perhaps if they weren't facing someone as fierce as Lady Nightingale.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_002_arthur_fa: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The only way to honor a fallen soldier is to finish the mission.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_003_arthur_re: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7But try remembering that while their blood stains your boots.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_004_arthur_lu: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7That's what I told Lucas when we first met.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_005_arthur_le: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7War had taught us both that lesson.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_006_arthur_hi: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7The rigid hierarchy of Allied command would look at Lucas and see only character flaws.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_007_arthur_in: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Insubordinate. Churlish. No stranger to a prison cell.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_009_arthur_pe: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7He was perfect for my team.
vidsubtitles/sp_th1_elo_vo_010_arthur_ri: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Even if he does have a mean right hook.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_002_arthur_ri: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7He had Richter distracted, and doubting everything he thought he knew.

vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_013_richter_g: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7That's how he's getting them out.

vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_021_richter_s: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7With the Soviets invading the city...
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_022_richter_n: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Lady Nightingale will be my leverage.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_023_richter_e: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I will exchange her for my own safe passage.

vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_036_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7Three years we have waited for this moment.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_043_freisinge: ^9Hermann Freisinger: ^7Hitler has paid for his weakness.

vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_055_polina_th: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7I can think of a few things.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_055_wade_what: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7What do we do with him?
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_056_lucas_fig: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7Figured you'd want the honors, boss.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_059_richter_p: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Project Phoenix! I can get you the evidence!
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_060_arthur_sh: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Shhh. You've already done your part.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_061_arthur_su: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Right of the suprasternal notch, below the clavicle.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_065_lucas_und: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7Yeah, he's taking the Reich underground.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_068_wade_kids: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7C'mon, kids, shit's on fire out here!
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_070_arthur_ge: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7We can get out. Right now.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_071_arthur_tr: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Get ourselves on the first transport, be home in time for supper.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_074_arthur_hu: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Hunt down Freisinger, bury the Reich for good.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_075_arthur_be: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7We might not make it out of Berlin, but neither will the Nazis.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_076_arthur_to: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Whatever we do, though, we do it together.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_080_wade_fuhr: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7Hey, it's not every day you get a chance to kill a Führer.
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_081_wade_cant: ^8Wade Jackson: ^7Can't turn that shit down, right? (laughs)
vidsubtitles/sp_th2_p08_di_085_polina_ki: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7I still haven't ruled out killing you all.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk1_swo_vo_001_arthur_in: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7The infamous Lady Nightingale brought Stalingrad back from the brink.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk1_swo_vo_002_arthur_in: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Her actions inspired the Russians to take back their city and go on the offensive.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk1_swo_vo_003_arthur_sh: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7By sheer force of will and a sniper's precision...
vidsubtitles/sp_tk1_swo_vo_004_arthur_ch: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Polina changed the course of the war for the Allies and her people.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk1_swo_vo_005_arthur_re: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7With that reputation, it was only a matter of time before we found her.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_001_richter_l: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7What would Freisinger want with a lowly officer on the Eastern Front?
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_003_richter_m: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7It matters a great deal to me, Fräulein.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_005_polina_ga: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7From what I could gather, Freisinger was recruiting Steiner for some special project.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_009_polina_ki: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7I was sent to kill Freisinger.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_010_lucas_bet: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7There's gotta be a better way out of here.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_011_richter_n: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7There is no way out of here.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_013_richter_i: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7You have decided to do the intelligent thing.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_014_arthur_in: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Open that door back up, and I'll show you the intelligent thing.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_015_lucas_ali: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7You can get me out alive?
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_019_lucas_tel: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7I'll tell you what you want to know.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_020_arthur_ty: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Typical Aussie. No honor. No loyalty.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_022_lucas_sac: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7I ain't gonna be the next sacrifice in your crusade, Pommy!
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_023_richter_p: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I hope your plan was worth it.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_025_richter_t: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I thought you'd be the one to put an end to your team's foolish agend-.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_026_lucas_kil: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7You killing each other now, are ya?
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_029_richter_c: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I know why you chose to cooperate.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_030_richter_o: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7I would not take orders from a negro either.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_031_lucas_wro: ^8Lucas Riggs (laughing): ^7You got it all wrong, mate.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_033_lucas_ski: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7I don't care what color his skin is.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_034_lucas_hea: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7Haven't you heard about the Aussies and the Brits?
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_035_lucas_flu: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7We were the pieces of shit flushed down the crown's dunny.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_036_richter_n: ^9Jannick Richter: ^7Yes, yes of course, but your nations are allies.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_037_lucas_mas: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7No, it was more like master-servant.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk2_p06_di_038_lucas_exp: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7I did what I did, because to every Brit folks like me are expendable.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk3_tki_vo_003_arthur_st: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7No stranger to a prison cell.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk3_tki_vo_005_arthur_so: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7You had to credit the S.O.E.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk3_tki_vo_006_arthur_sp: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7They were very good at spotting talent in the unlikeliest of places.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk3_tki_vo_008_arthur_sk: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7He was a skilled demolitionist with an explosive temperament.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk3_tki_vo_010_arthur_de: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7Out there in the desert, the Rats of Tobruk were like a family.
vidsubtitles/sp_tk3_tki_vo_012_arthur_br: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7They never did figure out how to get along with the brass.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_003_lucas_fuc: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7People die when command fucks up.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_004_richard_f: ^8Richard Webb: ^7How exactly is this Arthur’s fault?
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_005_lucas_on_: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7This is on him! And on Wade.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_008_richard_s: ^8Richard Webb: ^7If he shows his face again I’ll bloody kill him myself.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_009_polina_bl: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7Oh, yes. Let’s keep blaming each other instead of the Germans.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_010_polina_th: ^8Polina Petrova (Russian): ^7These men who can’t get past their own egos.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_011_arthur_eg: ^8Arthur Kingsley (Russian): ^7I’d say our egos have all taken a hit today.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_012_polina_im: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7Is that supposed to impress me?
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_015_polina_fr: ^8Polina Petrova: ^7Freisinger is going to kill us all.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_019_lucas_old: ^8Lucas Riggs: ^7Old friend of yours, is he?
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_021_lucas_ric:
^8Lucas Riggs: ^7Oh yeah?! What kind of his-
^8Richard Webb: ^7Look, forget Freisinger!
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_022_richard_a: ^8Richard Webb: ^7Arthur will get us out of this.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn1_p01_di_025_richard_s: ^8Richard Webb: ^7But I’ve seen him in action.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn2_p01_vo_002_arthur_fa: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Sometimes the only way to honor a fallen soldier is to finish the mission.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn2_p01_vo_003_arthur_tr: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7But try remembering that while their blood stains your boots.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn3_tni_vo_001_arthur_me: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7If you're meant to lead, you have to learn what it's like to lose men.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn3_tni_vo_002_arthur_di: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7To have them die trusting you.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn3_tni_vo_003_arthur_on: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7And there's only one way to learn that lesson.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn3_tni_vo_004_arthur_d_: ^8Arthur Kingsley: ^7First time I did was on D-Day...
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_002_henry_daw: ^8Henry Baker: ^7We've got until dawn to achieve our objective.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_003_henry_kra: ^8Henry Baker: ^7And it seems like the Krauts already know we're coming.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_004_henry_dem: ^8Henry Baker: ^7Now we've got one chance to demolish the coastal artillery.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_005_henry_fai: ^8Henry Baker: ^7But if we don't, the invasion tomorrow will fail.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_006_henry_tra: ^8Henry Baker: ^7Now I trained you all for this!
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_007_henry_nav: ^8Henry Baker: ^7Let's not let the Navy show us up.
vidsubtitles/sp_tn4_tni_di_008_henry_cas: ^8Henry Baker: ^7So take the casemates, blast the artillery, then fire your flares to let the Navy know the job's done.
vidsubtitles/sp_tt1_tgt_di_001_richard_k: ^8Richard Webb: ^7Well that was a fucking kerfuffle.
vidsubtitles/sp_tt2_tgt_vo_001_arthur_ei: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Eight men standing against a Nazi gun fort.
vidsubtitles/sp_tt2_tgt_vo_003_arthur_li: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7Sometimes, a little madness is called for.
vidsubtitles/sp_tt2_tgt_vo_004_arthur_de: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7I think deep down he understood that.
vidsubtitles/sp_tt2_tgt_vo_005_arthur_sa: ^8Arthur Kingsley (voice): ^7And realized we were cut from the same cloth.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi00_1: ^3Krafft: ^7The Nazis dream of a thousand-year Reich, but in truth they are already dead.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi01_1: ^3Krafft: ^7Their war machine shattered in Stalingrad, but their evil regime staggers on, desperate to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi02_1: ^3Krafft: ^7A special battalion of SS troops scoured the globe for a supernatural means to win the war.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi03_1: ^3Krafft: ^7They were led by the most dangerous man I ever met...
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi04_1: ^3Krafft: ^7Oberführer Wolfram Von List. It was he who destroyed my life... and cost me my soul.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi05_1: ^3Krafft: ^7Von List gathered experts from across the Reich -- archaeologists, explorers, historians...
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi06_1: ^3Krafft: ^7...and authorities on the occult -- like myself.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi07_1: ^3Krafft: ^7We were forced to help them loot sacred antiquities.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi08_1: ^3Krafft: ^7But none of the relics we found gave Von List the power he craved.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi09_1: ^3Krafft: ^7Then something happened in Poland that changed everything.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi10_1: ^3Krafft: ^7Another Nazi attempt to alter the course of the war...
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi11_1: ^3Krafft: ^7...somehow weakened the barrier between this world and the next...
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi13_1: ^3Krafft: ^7Many miles away, five of our artifacts suddenly... awakened.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi14: ^3Krafft: ^7Ancient spirits -- “demons” if you will -- beckoned from these otherworldly relics...
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi17_1: ^3Krafft: ^7He now has the power to raise the dead -- and a plan to take back everything the Nazis lost.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi18_1: ^3Krafft: ^7All the troops he will ever require lie frozen in the mass graves of the Eastern Front.
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi19_1: ^3Krafft: ^7To stop his unholy army, I must find allies...
vidsubtitles/zm_cmcp_intr_krft_zi20_1: ^3Krafft: ^7...or the thousand-year Reich will consume us all.

wegame/prologue:
Terrorism

The common enemy of human civilization.

In today's world, terrorist attacks are breaking out in many places around the world.

Counter-terrorism has become an important issue for all governments.

To protect unarmed civilians, nations around world are sending in special forces soldiers to seek and destroy extremist groups.

You will play different roles in this story to participate in Counter-terrorism campaign.

The task assigned to you is great and difficult.
